versions.changelog:
- No user-facing or internal changes; this is a republish of version 1.0.0.
- All code, configuration, and documentation remain unchanged.

Initial release of luban-skill: an industrial-grade skill optimizer for intelligent agents.

- Provides modular auto-optimization, scoring, inspection, and knowledge update workflows for agent skills.
- Supports keyword-triggered actions like skill optimization, auto-checks, and reviews.
- Implements detailed skill quality evaluation across 9 dimensions (structure, effectiveness, meta-skill).
- Includes event/interval/on-demand scheduling, error-driven patching, automated health checks, and knowledge updates.
- Outputs transparent reports (score diffs, recommendations, health inspections) for continuous skill improvement.
